Conversation Questions

Warm-Up

Main question: How was your trip to Australia?

Follow-up questions

  • Was it better than you expected?
  • What was the first thing you noticed after arriving?
  • Did anything surprise you?
  • How did your family enjoy the trip?
  • What did your family like the most?
  • Was anything difficult for them?
  • Did you have a good balance between family time and business time?

Answer help

The first thing I noticed was...

I was surprised by...

My family enjoyed...

More answer help

Conversation Questions

Brisbane

Main question: How was Brisbane?

Follow-up questions

  • What kind of city did it feel like?
  • Was it busy, relaxed, modern, or natural?
  • Could you imagine living or doing business there?
  • How was meeting your friend in Brisbane?
  • How long had it been since you last met?
  • What did you talk about?
  • Did he give you any useful advice about Australia?
  • What did you learn about Japanese culture in Australia?
  • Are Australians interested in Japan?
  • What parts of Japanese culture seem popular there?

Answer help

Brisbane felt...

It was more ... than I expected.

I think Brisbane is good for...

We talked about...

Conversation Questions

Café and Business Ideas

Main question: Did you talk about franchising your café?

Follow-up questions

  • What ideas did you discuss?
  • Did the idea feel realistic?
  • What would be the first step?
  • Do you think your café concept could work in Australia?
  • Which part of the concept would be attractive?
  • Would the charcoal latte work there?
  • What would you need to change for Australian customers?
  • Would menu size, portion size, iced drinks, brunch options, or interior style need to change?
  • What should stay the same?
  • Should you keep the design story, the charcoal latte, the Japanese atmosphere, or the roof-tile connection?

Answer help

The most realistic idea is...

The first step could be...

I think it could work because...

The strongest part is...

More answer help
  • The charcoal latte might...
  • I would keep ..., but change ...

  • Do they order big meals?

  • Do they take photos?
  • How is Australian café culture different from Japanese café culture?
  • Is it louder or quieter?
  • Is it more casual or more formal?
  • Are the portions bigger or smaller?
  • What kind of customer would like your café in Australia?

Conversation Questions

Problems and Risks

Main question: What problems did you notice?

Follow-up questions

  • Was rent high?
  • Was labor cost high?
  • Were food expectations different?
  • Was competition strong?
  • What would be difficult about opening a café in Australia?
  • Would finding staff, controlling quality, explaining the concept, or choosing location be difficult?
  • Would you start with a full café or a small market stall?
  • Which is safer for testing?
  • Which gives a stronger brand image?

The biggest risk might be...

We would need to...

  • A full café is attractive, but...

  • Was it with friends?
  • Was it during business talks or sightseeing?

Conversation Questions

Next Steps

Main question: What should you do next after this trip?

Follow-up questions

  • Should you talk again with your friend?
  • Should you test menu ideas?
  • Should you make a simple business plan?
  • Should you study costs in Australia?
  • What information do you still need?
  • Do you need to research rent, labor cost, food cost, licenses, or customer demand?
  • If everything goes well, what is your ideal future plan?
  • Would it be one market stall, one flagship café, more franchises, or a Japan-Australia design brand?

Answer help

The next step is...

First, I should...

Before making a big decision, I need to...

I still need to know...

We should research...

More answer help
  • It would be useful to compare...
  • In the future, I would like to...
